what: a hill giant: the plainest and dullest kind of giant, a very big, heavy, pot-bellied, slope-shouldered man standing on two legs, with a small head, a low brow, a dull slack-jawed hungry face with a big lower lip and gap teeth, a tangle of greasy brown hair, a stubbly chin, thick arms and big dirty bare feet. His skin is weather-beaten light tan, the skin of a man who lives outdoors.
colours: weather-beaten light tan skin, greasy dark brown hair, a patched dull grey-brown hide tunic, a dark brown wooden club.
wears: He wears only one rough sleeveless tunic of badly stitched brown animal hides, tied at the waist with a rope, reaching his knees. He has no armour, no metal anywhere, nothing on his head and bare feet.
holds: He grips exactly one big wooden club in his right fist: one single straight length of dark brown wood as long as his leg, narrow at the grip where his fist closes round it and swelling steadily to a fat rounded knobbly end. It is one piece of wood from end to end, with nothing fixed to it. His left hand is an empty open hand with nothing in it.
pose: He lumbers forward on two legs, one foot stamping ahead, his right arm lifted with the club gripped in his fist and raised high above his head ready to smash down, his empty left hand reaching out ahead of him to grab, mouth hanging open.
must_show: a big pot-bellied dull-faced giant man on two legs
ruddy-tan living skin, brown hair
rough hide tunic, no armour, no metal
one plain tree-branch club in the right hand, left hand empty
must_not_show: club with a crosspiece or hammer head
club lying across the shoulders unheld

what: a frost giant: a tall, broad, powerfully built giant man of Norse legend standing on two legs. His skin is pale glacier-blue on his face, chest, arms and legs alike. He has a long shaggy white beard, long wild white hair and frost-white eyebrows over pale glaring eyes. His chest and arms are bare. He has realistic adult proportions: a small head, very broad shoulders, long limbs, about eight heads tall.
colours: pale glacier-blue skin, white hair and beard, a shaggy white bear-fur kilt and shoulder pelt, dark brown leather straps, a club of clear blue-white ice.
wears: He wears a shaggy white bear-fur kilt, one white bear-fur pelt over his left shoulder held by a brown leather strap, and fur-wrapped boots. His head is bare. He has no metal armour at all.
holds: He holds exactly one ice club in his right hand: one thick heavy club made wholly of clear blue-white ice, like a giant icicle held by its thin end, thicker than his arm at the far end. His left hand is an empty clenched fist.
pose: He strides to the left on two legs with one foot forward, his right arm lifted high with the ice club raised over his head to strike, his left fist drawn back at his side, bearded jaw open in a shout.
must_show: giant man with pale blue skin
long white hair and beard, bare head
white fur kilt and pelt, bare chest and arms, no metal armour
one club of ice in the right hand, left fist empty
must_not_show: ice spikes growing from the body
cloud of mist around the body

what: a frost giant jarl: a chieftain of the frost giants of Norse legend, a tall, very broad, powerfully built giant man standing on two legs. His skin is pale glacier-blue on his face and hands. He has a stern proud face and a long thick white beard with a row of big clear icicles hanging from it. He has realistic adult proportions: a small head, very broad shoulders, long limbs, about eight heads tall.
colours: pale glacier-blue skin, a white beard hung with icicles, blue-black iron mail and blue-black iron helm, two pale ivory horns on the helm, a dark grey wolf-fur cloak, a silver cloak brooch and silver arm rings, an axe with a dark wooden haft and a broad pale ice-blue blade.
wears: He wears a chieftain's war gear: a long shirt of blue-black iron mail to his knees, a blue-black iron helm with an open face and two tall curved ivory horns, a heavy dark grey wolf-fur cloak pinned at the shoulder with a big round silver brooch, silver arm rings and fur-topped boots.
holds: He grips exactly one great axe in both hands, both hands on its haft: a long thick dark wooden haft with one very broad single curved blade of pale ice-blue at the top. He holds nothing else.
pose: He stands on two legs with his feet planted wide, turned a little to the left, the great axe held up across his body in both hands with its broad pale blade high beside his head, about to swing, cloak swept back.
must_show: giant man with pale blue skin and a white beard hung with icicles
dark blue-black mail shirt
horned iron helm
fur cloak with a silver brooch
one great axe with a broad pale blade, held in both hands
a chieftain: far better armed than the plain frost giant
must_not_show: ice spikes growing from the body
cloud of mist around the body

what: a frostfang giant: an outcast frost giant gone wild in the deep cold, a hulking, hunched, enormously broad giant standing on two legs. His skin is dark slate-blue on his face, chest, arms and legs alike. His great lower jaw juts forward, and from it two big bright white fangs, each as long as his nose and as thick as a finger, stick straight up outside his upper lip like a boar's tusks, plain to see against his dark face. A cluster of tall jagged spikes of clear ice grows straight out of the skin of each shoulder and along his upper back like a crest of crystals. He has a wild mane of white hair swept back from his face, no beard, and small glowing pale eyes.
colours: dark slate-blue skin, a white mane, two big bright white fangs, clear pale cyan ice spikes on the shoulders and back, a ragged charcoal-black hide kilt, a maul with a dark wooden haft and a huge block of pale cyan glacier ice for a head.
wears: He wears only a ragged charcoal-black hide kilt and a rope belt. He has no armour, no helmet and no cloak: the ice spikes growing from his shoulders are his only armour.
holds: He grips exactly one great maul with both fists, his right fist high on the haft and his left fist low on the haft, so that both hands are on the wood: a long thick dark wooden haft with a huge square block of pale cyan glacier ice bound to its top as the hammer head, the block as big as his own chest. He holds nothing else.
pose: He stands on two legs, hunched forward with knees bent, the maul held up across his chest in both fists with the ice block high above his right shoulder, about to smash down, head thrust forward, the two white fangs showing, jaw open roaring.
must_show: giant with dark slate-blue skin, darker than the other frost giants
two big white fangs jutting up from the lower jaw, visible in the small sprite
jagged ice spikes growing from the shoulders and back
one maul with a huge block of ice for a head, both hands on the haft
wild and savage, no armour, no helm
must_not_show: long white beard hiding the mouth
cloud of mist around the body

what: a fire giant: one of Surtr's people from the deep forges of Norse legend, a massive, thick-set, barrel-chested giant smith-warrior standing on two legs. His skin is coal-black on his face, arms and hands alike. His hair and long beard are bright flame-orange, swept upward and flickering like fire at the tips. His eyes glow orange. He has realistic adult proportions: a small head, very broad shoulders, thick limbs, about seven heads tall.
colours: coal-black skin, bright flame-orange hair and beard, glowing orange eyes, a scorched brown leather smith's apron and straps, dark iron bracers, a sword with a blade glowing yellow-orange like metal fresh from the forge.
wears: He wears a forge-hand's working kit and no armour: a long scorched brown leather smith's apron with a bib over his chest, belted at the waist, dark iron bracers and heavy boots. His head is bare and his arms are bare. He wears no crown and no cape.
holds: He holds exactly one great straight sword in his right hand: a very broad thick blade glowing yellow-orange from hilt to tip, with small flames licking along its edge. His left hand is an empty clenched fist.
pose: He strides to the left on two legs with one foot forward, his right arm raised with the glowing sword lifted high over his head for a downward cut, his left fist thrust out ahead for balance, mouth open in a war shout.
must_show: giant man with coal-black skin
flame-orange hair and beard
a smith's leather apron, bare arms, bare head, no plate armour
one broad sword with a glowing yellow-orange blade
left fist empty
must_not_show: glowing cracks all over the skin

what: a cloud giant: a proud giant lord from a castle on the storm clouds, the giant of the beanstalk tale, a true giant and no ordinary man. He is immensely heavy-boned and thick: a deep barrel chest, a thick neck, arms like tree boughs, legs like pillars, very big hands and very big booted feet. His skin is cold pale grey like weathered marble, a plain neutral grey with no other tint in it, on his face, arms, hands and legs alike, a colour no living man has. His face is a giant's: a long heavy jaw, a great hooked nose, a heavy overhanging brow and small cold pale eyes, clean-shaven, with the chin raised in contempt. His long white hair stands up and back from his head in one great heaped mass like a thunderhead. He has a small head for his body, very broad shoulders and thick limbs, about seven heads tall.
colours: cold pale neutral grey skin like weathered marble, white hair, a knee-length tunic of dark charcoal-grey wool with a wide silver border, a long cloak of deep indigo, a silver circlet, silver armbands and a wide silver-studded black belt, a morningstar with a dark iron handle and a dark iron spiked ball.
wears: He wears the finery of a giant lord: a knee-length tunic of dark charcoal-grey wool with a wide silver border, a wide black belt with silver studs, a broad shining silver circlet round his brow above his eyes, plainly seen, broad silver armbands on his bare upper arms, a long deep indigo cloak hanging from two big silver shoulder clasps, and heavy laced boots. He has no armour. His face is bare and clean-shaven: no beard and no moustache, his long heavy jaw and chin bare.
holds: In his right fist he grips exactly one spiked mace, a short heavy war club made of two parts joined together: one straight, smooth, thick dark iron handle as thick as his wrist and no longer than his forearm, whose bottom end is inside his fist with nothing below the fist, and, fixed on the top end of that handle with no gap between them, one big round dark iron ball as big as his head, studded all over with short thick iron spikes. The handle goes straight up into the centre of the underside of the ball and stops there. The handle itself is plain and smooth with no spikes or crossbars on it. There is no chain and no long pole. His left hand is empty, held open and raised palm-out in a gesture of disdain.
pose: He stamps to the left on two thick legs with his chin up, looking down his great nose, his right arm bent and lifted with the spiked mace held upright above his right shoulder, handle in his fist and the spiked ball on top of it beside his head, ready to swing down, his empty left hand raised palm-out before him, cloak and hair billowing.
must_show: white hair heaped up like a thunderhead, clean-shaven
one morningstar: a short thick handle with a big spiked iron ball, a weapon and not a staff
empty left hand
proud, not a ragged brute, and not a Greek god
a true giant: heavy-boned, thick-limbed, a long heavy jaw and great hooked nose, cold pale grey skin with no tint
a lord's finery: charcoal tunic with a silver border, silver circlet, indigo cloak
must_not_show: cloud of mist around the body
handle sticking out above the ball

what: a fire giant king: the king of the fire giants, kin of Surtr of Norse legend, a massive, enormously broad, barrel-chested giant standing on two legs. His skin has baked as dark and hard as slag: it is black and rough on his face and hands alike. His long forked beard and his hair are bright flame-orange, flickering like fire at the tips, and his eyes glow yellow-orange. He has realistic adult proportions: a small head, very broad shoulders, thick limbs, about seven heads tall.
colours: black slag-dark skin, bright flame-orange hair and forked beard, a tall black iron crown with gold points, ornate black iron plate armour with gold trim, a long dark crimson cape, a hammer with a black iron haft and a huge head glowing molten yellow-orange.
wears: He wears a tall black iron crown with five gold points, a full suit of ornate black iron plate armour edged with gold, great layered shoulder plates, a gold medallion on the breastplate, and a long dark crimson cape hanging from his shoulders. His face is uncovered.
holds: He holds exactly one great war hammer upright in his right fist, raised beside his head: one straight thick black iron haft, as long as his forearm, rises straight up out of his fist, its bottom end inside the fist with nothing below it, and on the top end of that same haft sits the hammer head, joined to it: one long heavy block lying crosswise across the top of the haft like the head of a smith's sledgehammer, three times as wide as it is tall, glowing molten yellow-orange like metal in a forge, with no flames on it. The whole hammer, haft and head, is on the left side of the picture beside his head, against the plain backdrop and clear of his body. His left hand is an empty clenched fist.
pose: He stands on two legs with his feet planted wide, turned a little to the left, his right arm bent and raised so his fist is beside his right shoulder holding the molten hammer upright on the left side of the picture, about to smash down, his left fist clenched before his belt, head lowered, glaring, beard and cape swept back.
must_show: giant with a black slag-dark face and hands
flame-orange beard and hair
tall crown, face uncovered
ornate black and gold plate armour and a crimson cape
one great hammer with a glowing molten head in the right hand, left fist empty
a king: far more ornate than the plain fire giant
must_not_show: hammer head floating apart from the haft
hammer head behind the other shoulder
short stub of haft in the fist
flames rising from the hammer head

what: the ghost of Hrungnir, the stone giant of Norse legend whom Thor slew: a colossal, enormously broad giant built entirely out of big rough-hewn blocks of dark grey granite fitted together like the stones of a castle wall, with deep black seams between the blocks, standing on two legs. His chest is a few huge slabs, his arms and legs are stacked boulders, his fists are single rocks, and his head is one square block of the same dark grey granite with a stern face chiselled into it: a heavy brow, a square jaw and a short squared beard cut in the stone. One wide jagged crack, the mark of Thor's hammer, splits the top of his stone head down to the brow, and bright pale cyan ghost-light shines out of that crack and out of his two eyes. In the middle of his chest a deep three-cornered hollow holds his heart: one sharp-edged triangle, point down, glowing pale cyan. He has a small head, very broad shoulders and thick limbs. Everything about him is cold dark grey rock.
colours: dark charcoal-grey and mid-grey granite blocks with black seams on every part of the body and head, pale grey chipped edges, pale cyan ghost-light in the eyes, in the skull crack and in the triangular heart, a round grey stone shield, a long dark grey whetstone bar.
wears: He wears nothing but his own stone: a kilt of hanging grey stone slabs is part of his body. He has no cloth and no metal.
holds: On his left arm he carries exactly one great round shield of thick grey stone, carved with a ring of angular runes. In his right hand he holds exactly one giant whetstone as a weapon: a long straight thick bar of dark grey stone with square corners, as long as his arm, like a huge stone brick, with no blade and no head.
pose: He strides to the left on two legs with one heavy stone foot forward, the round stone shield held out before his body on his left arm, his right arm cocked back over his shoulder with the long whetstone bar raised to hurl, stone jaw open in a roar.
must_show: a giant built of dark grey stone blocks, head included, plainly rock and not flesh
a three-cornered glowing heart in the middle of the chest
a jagged glowing crack down the top of the stone head
one round stone shield on the left arm
one long square stone bar (the whetstone) in the right hand
the most imposing giant of all, a legend
must_not_show: cloud of mist around the body

what: a fire beetle: a real tropical click beetle, an insect, drawn large, the kind that shines in the dark. It has a long narrow oval body, two hard ridged jet-black wing cases that meet in a straight line down its back, a broad black shield plate between head and wing cases, a small black head with two short curved biting jaws and two thin antennae, and six black jointed legs. Parts of its own shell shine from within like hot coals: on the shield plate behind its head are two big round spots of glowing orange-yellow, one on each side, flat in the shell like two burning eyes; and the whole rear tip of its body, behind the wing cases, glows the same orange-yellow.
colours: glossy jet-black wing cases, shield plate, head and legs with dull grey highlights; two round glowing orange-yellow spots on the shield plate behind the head; a glowing orange-yellow rear tip.
wears: It is an animal and wears nothing.
holds: It is an animal on six legs and holds nothing.
pose: Seen from the side and a little above, it scuttles to the left on its six legs with its head lowered and jaws open; the two glowing orange spots on its shield plate are at the left of the picture and its glowing orange rear tip is at the right, so there is orange light at both ends of the black beetle.

jet-black shell
two glowing orange spots in the shell just behind the head
a glowing orange rear tip, visible in the small sprite
must_not_show: anything standing up from its back
orange balls held in the mouth

what: a giant centipede: a real tropical centipede, an animal, drawn large. Its body is one long, flat, narrow ribbon of about twenty short glossy plates, all the same width from head to tail, far longer than it is wide. From each plate one pair of pointed jointed legs sticks straight out sideways, one to the left and one to the right, so that a neat row of legs runs down each edge of the ribbon. It has a small round flat head with two long thick antennae and, at the front of the head, a pair of curved black fangs like two hooks. Two long spiny legs trail back from its last plate.
colours: glossy dark red-brown body plates, bright yellow-orange legs and antennae, a bright rust-red head, black fang tips.
wears: It is an animal and wears nothing.
holds: It is an animal and holds nothing.
pose: Seen from above, like a centipede crawling across a table, its long ribbon body bent in a big S-shaped wave that fills the picture, head at the upper left and tail at the lower right, the rows of yellow-orange legs fanned out on both sides of the body all the way along, antennae spread, the two hooked fangs open.

It has a small triangular head with two huge bulging eyes at the top corners and two short thin antennae, a long thin stick-like neck section held upright, a long narrow abdomen with folded leaf-like wings lying along it, four long thin walking legs, and two big folded front legs lined with rows of sharp spines.

two big spined front legs folded and raised
leaf-green colour
standing on four thin legs

big open pincers held out in front (in side view the near pincer hides most of the far one)
one thick segmented tail arched over the back, ending in one curved sting

It has a fierce hooked yellow beak, a flat feathered head with a stern brow, broad powerful wings, feathered legs and big yellow feet with black talons.

It has a short broad dragon's head with two short backswept horns and a heavy jaw, a thick neck, a deep chest, four stout legs with black claws, a ridge of small blunt spikes along its back and a thick tail. Its belly and throat glow dull orange from the fire inside, showing between the scales. Its back is smooth except for the ridge of spikes.

belly and throat glowing orange

what: a harpy of Greek myth: a monster with the head of a human woman on the body of a big brown bird. Her head is a real human head, as large as the bird's whole chest: the pale, gaunt, sharp-cheeked face of a fierce old woman, with human skin, a long human nose, thin human lips, a pointed human chin, two angry human eyes under dark brows, and long tangled black hair streaming from her scalp. Her mouth is a human mouth, open wide and shrieking, showing teeth. Below her chin a thick ruff of pale feathers circles her neck like a collar, and from there down she is all bird: a plump body covered in feathers, two broad feathered wings, a fan tail and two scaly yellow bird legs with big hooked talons.
colours: a pale sallow human face, long tangled black hair, dusky brown and grey-brown body and wing feathers with darker wing tips, a pale cream feather ruff round the neck, yellow scaly legs with black talons.

holds: She holds nothing; both taloned feet are empty and open.
pose: She swoops down towards the left with nothing beneath her, both wings raised high above her back, her two taloned bird feet thrust forward and spread to snatch; her woman's face is turned towards the viewer so the whole face shows, mouth open in a shrieking song, black hair streaming back.
must_show: a bird's body covered in feathers, with wings and taloned bird legs
a human woman's face (nose, lips, chin, no beak) with long dark hair, readable in the small sprite
feather ruff at the neck, everything below it feathered
swooping with talons forward

what: an Empusa of Greek myth: a demoness of the crossroads sent by Hecate, in her true form. She is a thin, graceful, upright woman with a stern gaunt pale face, sharp fangs, glowing yellow eyes and long wild hair of bright flame-red. She walks on exactly two legs, and the two legs do not match; both show below the hem of her dress from mid-shin down. Her first leg, at the left of the picture, is a shining golden bronze metal leg with a golden bronze human foot, like the leg of a bronze statue. Her second leg, at the right of the picture, is the leg of a faun: shaggy dark grey fur down the shin, ending in one black cloven hoof where the foot should be. Her hands have long black claws. She has realistic adult proportions: a small head, long limbs, about eight heads tall.
colours: pale ash-white skin on the face and hands, flame-red hair, yellow eyes, a long charcoal-black dress with a dull gold border, one shining golden bronze metal leg and foot, one shaggy dark grey faun's leg with a black hoof, black claws.

flame-red hair, pale face, fangs
one shining golden bronze leg and foot
one grey furred leg ending in a black hoof

what: Lamia of Greek myth, the grieving serpent-queen of Libya: a woman above the waist and one great serpent below. Her upper half is a tall, stately, sorrowful queen with a pale cold ash-white face, dark hollows round her eyes, two thin fangs and long straight black hair. At her waist her body becomes one single enormous snake's body, as thick as her waist, which curves down and winds into two heavy coils and ends in a pointed tail tip raised behind her. She rises upright from her own coils. She has a small head, a long neck and long arms.
colours: pale ash-white skin on the face and hands, long black hair, a dark crimson long-sleeved robe with a gold border, a tall gold crown and a broad gold collar, a serpent body of dark emerald-green scales with a pale gold belly, black nails.
wears: She wears a queen's dark crimson robe with a high neckline and long wide sleeves to the wrists, edged with gold, which covers her whole upper body from throat to waist and ends in a gold belt where the serpent scales begin; a broad gold collar across her shoulders; and a tall gold crown on her head.
holds: Her hands are empty and she holds nothing; both arms are held out wide and open, ready to embrace.
pose: She rears up tall on her coiled serpent body, leaning to the left, both arms opened wide and reaching forward as if to embrace, head tilted, mouth a little open showing the two fangs, the coils of her serpent half heaped beneath her and the tail tip curling up behind.
must_show: a crowned woman above the waist, fully clothed in a long-sleeved crimson robe
one thick serpent body below the waist, coiled, with green scales
tall gold crown and gold collar: a queen
pale face, black hair
empty arms opened wide

what: Cerberus, the three-headed hound of Hades from Greek myth: one enormous, heavy, deep-chested black guard dog on four legs, a real mastiff-like hound, with three dog heads. Three long thick necks spring from its one pair of shoulders and spread wide apart like the ribs of an open fan, with the backdrop showing between them: the left head is turned out to the left and held low, the middle head is lifted high and faces the viewer, the right head is turned out to the right at shoulder height. Each head is a whole separate mastiff's head with its own short cropped ears, two large round eyes of solid glowing red, and wide-open jaws with big white fangs and a red tongue. The hound has no dog's tail: where its tail should be, one thick scaly snake grows out of its rump, curves up behind it like a raised tail and ends in a snake's head with open jaws. The snake is the tail.
colours: short black fur with slate-grey highlights on every muscle and along each neck, large glowing red eyes on all three heads, white fangs, red tongues, a dull olive scaly snake for a tail, a heavy dark iron spiked collar on each neck.
wears: It wears three heavy dark iron collars with short spikes, one on each neck.
holds: It is a beast on four legs and holds nothing.
pose: Seen from the front and a little from its right side, it stands braced on four legs with its chest toward the viewer and its body running back to the right, front legs planted wide, hackles up, its three necks spread like a fan, the left head low and snarling to the left, the middle head high and roaring at the viewer, the right head snapping to the right, backdrop plainly showing between the three necks, the snake tail hooked up behind the rump at the upper right, hissing.
must_show: one hound's body on four legs
exactly three dog heads on three necks spread apart like a fan, each head separate in the small sprite, backdrop between the necks
black fur, large red eyes, fangs
a snake for a tail, raised, ending in a snake's head
a huge fearsome guard dog
must_not_show: dog's furry tail as well as the snake
one wide head with three mouths

what: a mind flayer's thrall: a thin human man whose mind has been emptied and filled with his master's will, and who carries his master's mark where all can see it. His skin is colourless grey-white like candle wax on his face, hands and feet alike. He has a shaved bald head, hollow cheeks, blank white staring eyes and a jaw hanging wide open. Clamped on the top of his bald skull like a cap sits his master's leech: one slick, glistening, deep violet-purple creature as big as two fists, a smooth domed lump with four short thick tentacles that grip down over his head, one down each temple in front of the ear, one down the middle of his forehead to the bridge of his nose, one down the back of his skull. It is bright violet against the pale head and plainly a separate living thing riding him. His own face below it is a man's face with a nose, a mouth and a chin. A heavy dark iron collar is locked round his neck. He has realistic adult proportions: a small head, long thin limbs, about eight heads tall.
colours: colourless grey-white waxy skin, blank white eyes, one slick deep violet-purple tentacled leech on top of the skull, a ragged faded brown robe, a dark iron collar.
wears: He wears a ragged, torn, faded brown scholar's robe with tattered sleeves and a tattered hem at his shins, a rope belt, bare feet, and the heavy dark iron collar. His head is bald and bare but for the violet leech clamped on it.
holds: His hands are empty and he holds nothing. He has no weapon and no staff.
pose: He lurches to the left on two legs, body leaning forward, head tipped back with the jaw wide open and the violet leech gripping his skull, both arms reaching forward to the left with the hands open and the fingers spread to seize, one arm a little higher than the other, one bare foot dragging behind.
must_show: a thin bald human man with grey-white waxy skin, blank eyes, jaw hanging
his master's mark: one violet-purple tentacled leech clamped on top of his skull, plain in the small sprite
his own human face below it: nose, mouth, chin
both arms reaching forward, empty hands
ragged brown robe, iron collar

what: a mind flayer: a tall, thin, upright creature with a man's body and a head like an octopus. Its head is a big smooth bald domed mauve head with two small slanted eyes that glow pure white, and where a nose, mouth and chin should be there hang four long thick tentacles that reach down to its chest and curl at the tips. Its skin is slick mauve-purple on the head and hands alike. Its hands are thin with three long fingers and a thumb. It has a small body next to its head, narrow shoulders and long thin arms.
colours: slick mauve-purple skin on the head, tentacles and hands, white glowing eyes, long black robes with a dark red lining and silver trim, a tall stiff black collar, a silver amulet.
wears: It wears long black scholar's robes to the floor with silver trim, a dark red sash, and a very tall stiff black collar that stands up behind its head like a fan. Its head is bare.
holds: Its hands are empty and it holds nothing. Its right hand is raised with two fingertips pressed to its own temple; its left hand is thrust out ahead with the long fingers spread. It has no staff and no weapon.
pose: It glides to the left on two legs under its long robes, leaning forward, right hand at its temple, left hand thrust out with fingers spread, the four face tentacles lifted and reaching forward towards its victim.
must_show: an octopus-like bald domed head with long tentacles hanging where the mouth should be
mauve-purple skin
white glowing eyes
long black robes with a tall stiff collar
empty hands, one at the temple, one thrust out

what: a gelatinous cube: one single perfect cube of clear wobbling jelly, as tall as it is wide, with straight edges, flat faces and sharp corners, seen from a little above and to one side so that its top face and two side faces show. The jelly is see-through and dim, a dull dark olive-green like bottle glass full of ditch water, with one thin pale wet gleam along its top edges and no other shine. Hanging inside the middle of the jelly, held upright as if floating, is one whole pale grey-ivory human skeleton, and near it float one rusted sword, one dark dented iron helmet and a few dull brass coins. The cube is only jelly and the things caught inside it.
colours: see-through dull dark olive-green jelly, darker at the edges and corners, with one thin pale wet gleam along the top edges; a pale grey-ivory skeleton inside; a dark rusted sword and a dark iron helmet inside; a few dull brass coins inside. Dim and dirty, never bright.

a whole skeleton floating upright inside it, readable in the small sprite
a sword or helmet and coins inside it too

what: a ghast: a cunning grave-robbing corpse, a lean, wiry, hunched dead man standing on two legs. Every part of it is dead flesh, corpse-grey with a dull violet tinge, never living pink: the head, chest, arms and legs alike. It has a bald skull-like head with sunken cheeks, sly narrowed yellow eyes that are sharp and clever, a wide grinning mouth of long pointed teeth, a long dark tongue hanging out, pointed ears, and very long arms ending in long hooked black claws. It has a small head, long thin limbs and a bony chest with the ribs showing under the skin.

holds: Its hands are empty and it holds nothing; both clawed hands are open.

long hooked black claws, empty hands

what: the ghost of an einherjar: the spirit of a Norse warrior who was left out of Valhalla, a tall, broad, bitter-faced veteran Viking. He is a ghost, see-through and colourless: his whole figure, face, beard, armour, shield and sword alike, is one pale ghostly blue-white colour like moonlit mist, with darker steel-blue shadows and no other colour anywhere. He has a long braided beard, a grim scowling face and blank shining white eyes. Below the knees his legs thin away into ragged trailing wisps of pale mist, so that he drifts above the ground. He has realistic adult proportions: a small head, broad shoulders, long limbs.

wears: He wears a Viking warrior's gear, all of it ghost-pale blue-white: a round domed helm with a nose guard and no horns, a knee-length mail shirt, a wide belt and a short ragged cloak.
holds: He holds exactly one broad straight Viking sword in his right hand, the blade shining white. On his left arm he carries exactly one big round shield with a round boss in its centre; the shield is the same pale ghostly blue-white as the rest of him.
pose: He rushes to the left through the air, leaning forward, the round shield held out before his body on his left arm, his right arm raised with the sword swung high over his head for a downward cut, bearded mouth wide open in a battle shout, his legs trailing away behind him into wisps below the knees.

the whole figure pale ghost-blue-white, shield included, clearly a ghost
legs fading into wisps below the knees
one sword raised in the right hand
one round shield on the left arm
shouting, charging
